critical_findings: Multiple policies target the 'public' role rather than 'authenticated' — functionally similar via auth.uid() but not best-practice.
audit_log has no INSERT policy — only SELECT for own rows; writes rely on SECURITY DEFINER trigger.
No empresa_id predicate exists in any policy.

policies.future_multi_tenant_risk: HIGH — no empresa_id filter; multi-company users would see only their own auth.uid rows but any user with membership in multiple companies would see mixed data unless empresa_id is added
